info.name: Employee Management API
info.description: Postman collection for the implemented API, including private S3 employee-document upload, listing, presigned download, and deletion. Use development data only. Set a private test bucket in the API environment. Run npm run seed:dev-admin locally and place its token in adminAccessToken for HR/admin operations. The employeeId variable is the employee profile ID, distinct from employeeUserId.

request.description: Requires HR/admin access token. Automatically stores the account ID matching testEmail for the Create employee request.

exec: pm.test('HTTP status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

const j=pm.response.json(); pm.test('data is an array and contains no password fields', function () { pm.expect(j.data.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.data.pagination).to.have.property('total'); j.data.items.forEach(u => { pm.expect(u).not.to.have.property('password'); pm.expect(u).not.to.have.property('passwordHash'); }); });

const match=j.data.items.find(u => u.email === pm.collectionVariables.get('testEmail')); pm.test('Registered test account is available to HR', function () { pm.expect(match, 'register the test account first and use an HR token').to.exist; }); if (match) pm.collectionVariables.set('employeeUserId', match.id);

item.name: Employee Documents - S3 private object storage

exec: const j=pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('documentId', j.data.id);
pm.test('HTTP status is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

pm.test('Document metadata is returned without storage internals', function () { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.data).to.include.all.keys('id','employeeId','originalFilename','mimeType','sizeBytes','createdAt'); pm.expect(j.data).not.to.have.property('storageFilename'); pm.collectionVariables.set('documentId', j.data.id); });
pm.test('HTTP status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Document list includes pagination metadata', function () { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.data.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.data.pagination).to.include.all.keys('page','limit','total','totalPages'); });

const j=pm.response.json(); if (j.success && j.data?.downloadUrl) { const u=new URL(pm.collectionVariables.get('baseUrl') + j.data.downloadUrl); pm.collectionVariables.set('downloadToken', u.searchParams.get('token')); }
pm.test('HTTP status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

const j=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Download link is short-lived', function () { pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.data.downloadUrl).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.data.expiresInSeconds).to.be.a('number'); });
if (j.success && j.data?.downloadUrl) { const url=j.data.downloadUrl; pm.collectionVariables.set('downloadUrl', /^https?:\/\//i.test(url) ? url : pm.collectionVariables.get('baseUrl') + url); }
pm.test('Download returns the stored file', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Download has a file content type', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.match(/application\/pdf|image\/(png|jpeg)/i); });
pm.test('HTTP status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Delete response confirms success', function () { const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.message).to.include('deleted'); });

item.name: Attack: SQL injection in employee search

request.description: Sends SQL injection text as a search value. Set adminAccessToken first; the bound parameter must remain ordinary search text.

exec: pm.test('SQL injection payload is handled as an ordinary query', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.data.pagination.total).to.be.a('number'); });

item.name: Attack: employee attempts to list all employees

request.description: Uses an employee-role access token against the all-employees endpoint; access must be denied.

exec: pm.test('Employee cannot enumerate all employee records', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.code).to.eql('FORBIDDEN'); });

item.name: Attack: unsigned JWT with alg none

request.description: Attempts an unsigned JWT with alg none; the API must reject the token.

exec: pm.test('Unsigned JWT is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.code).to.eql('UNAUTHENTICATED'); });
